data.title: 平冢静 · 深夜拉面店外的暖罐咖啡
data.description: 深夜吃完拉面后的寂静街道上，平冢静倚在红色跑车车门旁。她将一罐温热的罐装黑咖啡贴在你的脸颊上，嘴角扬起带着几分痞气的帅气宠溺笑意。
data.location: quiet late-night Japanese street outside a cozy ramen stall
data.action: leaning against her red sports car outside a steaming late-night ramen shop, pressing a hot canned coffee against partner cheek with a roguish affectionate grin
data.lighting: warm yellow glow from ramen paper lanterns cutting through crisp night air
data.mood: cool mature sister charm, midnight camaraderie, subtle heart-thumping romance
data.promptProse: Leaning on her red sports car on a night street, Shizuka Hiratsuka presses a warm canned coffee against partner cheek with a roguish loving smirk.
data.animaCaption: Shizuka Hiratsuka leaning on sports car with warm coffee at night.
